def: Naarah, the name of an Israelitess, and of a place in Palestine

occurrences.text: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.
And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
